content: {"episode_id":"ep-05089","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal contests the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for which SilverBridge Advantage states precertification was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and episodes of dizziness (R42) that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). As stated in the note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias. We submit this clinical documentation as the justification requested in your notice and ask that the CO-197 denial be overturned and the outstanding balance of 709.93 be reconsidered."}
